h1_1_role_dependence_androidcontrol_2024.name: Chi-square test of independence
h1_1_role_dependence_androidcontrol_2024.note: Cramer's V CI from 2,000 parametric bootstrap replicates.
h1_1_role_dependence_androidcontrol_2024.hypothesis: H1.1 (androidcontrol_2024). Label status is not independent of element role.

h1_1_role_dependence_rico_2017.name: Chi-square test of independence
h1_1_role_dependence_rico_2017.note: Cramer's V CI from 2,000 parametric bootstrap replicates.
h1_1_role_dependence_rico_2017.hypothesis: H1.1 (rico_2017). Label status is not independent of element role.

h1_2_icon_gap_androidcontrol_2024.name: Two-proportion z test
h1_2_icon_gap_androidcontrol_2024.note: The CI is Newcombe's hybrid score interval on the risk difference (androidcontrol_2024 icon-like minus androidcontrol_2024 other). Cohen's h is reported without an interval and is interpreted using Cohen's conventions (.20 small, .50 medium, .80 large).
h1_2_icon_gap_androidcontrol_2024.hypothesis: H1.2 (androidcontrol_2024). Coverage among icon-like elements differs from coverage among other elements needing a label.

h1_2_icon_gap_rico_2017.name: Two-proportion z test

h1_2_icon_gap_rico_2017.hypothesis: H1.2 (rico_2017). Coverage among icon-like elements differs from coverage among other elements needing a label.

tables.name: overall_coverage
tables.caption: Overall label coverage by corpus.
tables.note: 'Needs label' excludes containers, web views, and elements named by their own visible text. Icon-like is the strictest subpopulation: a tappable graphic with no text.

tables.name: coverage_by_role
tables.caption: Label coverage by element role and corpus.
tables.note: Roles are assigned from the class name alone in both corpora, so the two are classified from identical information. Containers and web views are exempt from labelling and therefore have no denominator; they are omitted rather than shown at a spurious 100%.

tables.name: coverage_by_category
tables.caption: Label coverage by Play Store category (Rico only).
tables.note: Sorted by coverage. Categories are self-reported by developers and are not mutually exclusive in practice.

tables.name: coverage_by_rating
tables.caption: Label coverage by Play Store rating band (Rico only).
tables.note: Rating is an app-level attribute applied to every element of that app, so elements are not independent within an app. Treat this as descriptive.

figures.name: rq1_coverage_by_role
figures.caption: Label coverage by element role and corpus. Hatching duplicates the colour encoding for greyscale print.

figures.name: rq1_overall_coverage
figures.caption: Overall label coverage with 95% Wilson intervals.

notes: H1.3 involved 27 category comparisons; p-values are reported unadjusted in each line with the Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted value appended.
All proportions carry Wilson score intervals, which stay correct at the extreme rates seen in these corpora where Wald intervals would not.
Cells with fewer than 30 elements requiring a label are reported in tables but excluded from significance testing.
limitations: The view hierarchy cannot distinguish a decorative image from a meaningful one, so elements coded 'unlabelled' include some that genuinely need no description. Every coverage figure is therefore a lower bound and every debt figure an upper bound.

Elements are nested within screens and screens within apps, so they are not independent observations. The chi-square tests here treat them as such and are best read as descriptive; RQ4 models the dependence explicitly.
